A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''worker''' was sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] during its [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] to assist with a [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|base]] that was being manned by [[Unidentified Wookiee worker|three]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 2|other]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|workers]].
